context.serialization: question + whole previous segments + whole current segment; oldest whole segments dropped until BOTH tokenizers fit; current segment never truncated

deployment: the bundle directory is read-only or the process runs with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1: verification refuses any file not listed in the manifest, including __pycache__; one bundle per process
dynamics_prior: diagnostic forecast from own past outputs before reading the segment; already fused into primary by the learned fusion layer

methods.DetectorV1(manifest_path, device, verify: verifies every bundle file, the recomputed bundle_id, the executing API file, the imported runtime modules and the pinned base-model files
methods.observe(completed_segment): exactly once per segment, in order, after the boundary is confirmed; push is the identical native name
methods.primary_history(): copy of immutable native +0 records of the current trace
methods.reset(trace_id, question): new trace; empties segments, primary/latest records, own history and dynamics state
methods.save_session(directory) / restore_sessio: resumable state of ONE trace as immutable generations behind ACCEPTED.json; bound to bundle_id, API file SHA256 and session file SHA256; load only own trusted directories
methods.view(end_of_trace=False): observational as-of spans, not resumable state; snapshot is the identical native name

not_provided: same-label span boundaries or semantic span ids
predictions for an unfinished current segment
overflow: status='overflow': current segment alone does not fit; no answer, own history reset; availability status, not an annotation mask
own_history: detached own latest probabilities and focus representations of up to 16 previous consecutive eligible segments; reset at trace start and overflow
precision: bf16 backbone on CUDA; heads, own-history GRU and dynamics prior float32
primary: immutable +0 answer: 6 independent event sigmoids, 6-way mode softmax; decisions with final validation-only F1 thresholds; null decision where validation had no positives
revisions: append-only; identity target_sid/target_sample_id/as_of_sid/as_of_sample_id/as_of_input_sha256/revision_id/lag; native horizon 1..16; exact-lag thresholds only for lags with validation calibration
sample_ids: online ids are '<trace_id>:<sid>'; the frozen corpus uses sha256(json([trace_id,sid])); identity is the pair (trace_id, sid)
spans: half-open [seg_start, seg_end) runs of the latest argmax mode; left/right censoring flags; last span open until a different mode or an actually observed end of trace
unknown: UNKNOWN is target-side only. The detector always emits all probabilities; a low probability or a disabled threshold is not a known negative.
